纸片刹车.cultural_meaning: Popularized after the Xiaomi SU7 standard version suffered severe brake pad wear down to the backing plate and complete brake fade after just 2-3 laps on the Shanghai Tianma Circuit, leading to a crash into the tire wall. Netizens mocked the tiny brake pads as being as thin as paper sheets on a 300-horsepower electric sedan.
纸片刹车.example_quote: 小米SU7这纸片刹车跑两圈天马赛道就直接磨光撞墙，雷总管这叫人车合一？

误触锁单.literal_meaning: Accidentally touching to lock the vehicle order
误触锁单.cultural_meaning: During the launch night of the Xiaomi SU7, hundreds of consumers claimed they accidentally locked their orders (forfeiting the 5,000 RMB deposit) due to confusing app UI and aggressive confirmation flows, sparking mass complaints on Weibo demanding non-refundable deposit refunds.
误触锁单.example_quote: 刚点进去看配置不小心误触锁单，五千定金直接打水漂，小米这UI设计绝对是故意的！

军儿.literal_meaning: Little Jun (diminutive nickname for Lei Jun)
军儿.cultural_meaning: An ironic yet affectionate moniker for Xiaomi founder Lei Jun. Netizens create memes with mock phone calls saying '军儿，收手吧，外面全是吉利' ('Jun-er, give up, outside it's all Geely waiting for you') referring to Geely surrounding Xiaomi with competing Zeekr and Galaxy models.
军儿.example_quote: 军儿，外面全是吉利极氪围剿，你这21.59万顶得住不？

米粉税.cultural_meaning: The premium paid by loyal Xiaomi smartphone/smart-home fans for first-generation Xiaomi auto products and branded accessories, such as 499 RMB snap-on physical dashboard buttons or 99 RMB phone mounts, viewed as exploiting fan loyalty.
米粉税.example_quote: 买个中控物理按键都要499，雷总真是把米粉税收到了极致。

放大镜造车.literal_meaning: Building cars under a magnifying glass
放大镜造车.cultural_meaning: Coined by Lei Jun in media interviews to lament the unprecedented level of public and competitor scrutiny directed at Xiaomi SU7, where any minor panel gap, uneven seam, or loose bolt became a trending topic on Weibo and Douyin.
放大镜造车.example_quote: 全网都在拿放大镜造车盯着小米，掉点漆掉个螺丝都能上热搜第一。

掉漆门.cultural_meaning: Delivery scandal where brand-new Xiaomi SU7 cars arrived at delivery centers with chipped, scratched, or peeling paint on front bumpers and wheel arches, forcing Xiaomi to offer point compensations.
掉漆门.example_quote: 提车刚开出交付中心就发现保险杠掉漆，这就是所谓的豪车级涂装工艺？

螺丝门.cultural_meaning: Early customer delivery reports and teardown videos showing missing, mismatched, or loose fastener screws on Xiaomi SU7 bottom covers and wheel well liners, triggering debate about startup assembly line quality control.
螺丝门.example_quote: 底盘护板螺丝都能少装两个，小米这品控线真的通过质检了吗？

物理按键配件.pinyin: wù lǐ àn jiàn pèi jiàn
物理按键配件.cultural_meaning: Refers to Xiaomi selling an aftermarket physical keyboard strip for 499 RMB to attach underneath the central touchscreen, mocked by car enthusiasts as taking away basic standard automotive controls only to sell them back as paid DLC.
物理按键配件.korean_equiv: 유료 추가 옵션 물리 버튼 악세서리
物理按键配件.example_quote: 原车把物理按键全砍了，转头卖499的拓展按键配件，吃相太难看了。

保费刺客.cultural_meaning: The shocking discovery by EV buyers that annual insurance premiums exceed 8,000 to 12,000 RMB (often 50-100% higher than equivalent gas cars) due to integrated die-cast aluminum bodies requiring total part replacement upon minor rear collisions.
保费刺客.example_quote: 20多万的车第一年保费报出来一万一，车价省的那点油钱全送给保费刺客了。

韭菜车.cultural_meaning: Cars whose manufacturers slash official prices by tens of thousands of RMB or launch upgraded facelifts shortly after deliveries begin, metaphorically harvesting early buyers like leeks (韭菜) in Chinese agriculture.
韭菜车.example_quote: 提车不到三个月厂家直接官降三万，老车主瞬间变成被割得干干净净的韭菜车。

老韭菜.cultural_meaning: Veteran early-adopter EV owners who have suffered multiple rounds of sudden manufacturer price reductions, hardware obsolescence, and OTA power/charging throttles, now warning new prospective buyers.
老韭菜.example_quote: 作为第一批买新势力老韭菜，奉劝大家千万别冲首发，等半年骨折价再说。

迪王背刺.cultural_meaning: BYD's aggressive market price slashing, such as launching the Qin Plus DM-i and EV 'Glory Edition' at 79,800 RMB, which slashed residual values for existing BYD owners overnight and sparked furious protests in WeChat owner groups.
迪王背刺.example_quote: 年底刚买的秦Plus开春就出荣耀版降了两万，迪王背刺老车主真是毫不手软。

零整比上天.cultural_meaning: Sky-high repair and spare-parts prices relative to overall vehicle cost. Replacing a cracked laser LiDAR unit, Matrix LED headlamp, or rear casting can cost up to 30-50% of the entire vehicle's purchase price.
零整比上天.example_quote: 倒车碰坏一个激光雷达报价一万八，这零整比上天了，小刮蹭就得报全损。

车库罚站.literal_meaning: Standing at attention in the garage (punishment)
车库罚站.cultural_meaning: EV owners trapped in underground parking basements unable to unlock or start their vehicles because cloud-dependent digital key apps and server handshakes fail without 4G/5G cellular coverage.
车库罚站.example_quote: 地库没手机信号，蓝牙钥匙死活连不上车，大半夜在车库罚站半小时吹冷风。

坐小板凳.literal_meaning: Sitting on a tiny low stool
坐小板凳.cultural_meaning: Uncomfortable rear-seat posture in electric sedans caused by the thick underfloor battery pack elevating floor height, forcing passengers to sit with bent knees and zero thigh support like sitting on kindergarten stools.
坐小板凳.korean_equiv: 쪼그려 앉기 후석 시트 (다리 붕 뜸)
坐小板凳.example_quote: 后排地台被电池顶得老高，坐进去大腿完全悬空，坐两小时跟坐小板凳受罪一样。

铁板烧天幕.cultural_meaning: Canopy panoramic glass roofs with zero physical retractable sunshades, turning car cabins into scorching ovens under summer sunlight and cooking drivers' scalps like meat on a teppanyaki griddle.
铁板烧天幕.example_quote: 大夏天开没遮阳帘的全景天幕，头顶热得像铁板烧，戴草帽开空调都救不回来。

密室逃脱.cultural_meaning: Electronic flush door handles and power release latches failing during vehicle power outages, submerged water accidents, or post-collision fires, trapping occupants inside like a horror escape room.
密室逃脱.korean_equiv: 비상 탈출 불가 밀실 지옥 (전자식 도어 고장)
密室逃脱.english_equiv: Escape room cabin lockout during crash
密室逃脱.example_quote: 发生追尾全车断电隐藏把手弹不出，车内机械拉手藏在缝里，生死关头玩密室逃脱呢？

断头台电吸门.pinyin: duàn tóu tái diàn xī mén
断头台电吸门.cultural_meaning: Motorized soft-close doors lacking reliable anti-pinch obstacle sensors, notorious for mercilessly crushing and fracturing fingers, carrots, or catching coats with hydraulic-like closing force.
断头台电吸门.example_quote: 极氪的电吸门防夹逻辑简直是笑话，夹到小孩手指都不停，妥妥的断头台电吸门。

屏幕换挡.cultural_meaning: Eliminating traditional physical gear stalks (as in Tesla Model 3 Highland, Zeekr 007) and forcing drivers to swipe up and down on the edge of the center touchscreen to engage Drive or Reverse, dangerous in three-point turns or emergency panics.
屏幕换挡.example_quote: 倒车调头还要在屏幕上划来划去换挡，屏幕死机卡顿是不是直接别开车了？

墓碑中控屏.cultural_meaning: Giant, vertical tablet screens protruding abruptly from the middle of the dashboard like a gravestone, ruining aesthetic cabin cohesion and obstructing bottom-right road visibility.
墓碑中控屏.example_quote: 中控台硬插一块巨大垂直大屏，反光严重还挡视线，远远看过去像立了个墓碑。

冰箱彩电大沙发.pinyin: bīng xiāng cǎi diàn dà shā fā
冰箱彩电大沙发.cultural_meaning: A satirical catchphrase coined to mock Chinese NEV makers (originally Li Auto) who lure buyers with consumer electronics gimmicks (foldable ceiling screens, onboard cooling fridges, zero-gravity reclining seats) while neglecting suspension tuning, mechanical durability, and chassis dynamics.
冰箱彩电大沙发.english_equiv: Refrigerator, TV, and big sofa (living room gimmicks)
冰箱彩电大沙发.example_quote: 某些新势力底盘稀烂毫无操控，全靠冰箱彩电大沙发忽悠带娃奶爸掏钱。

旋转屏.cultural_meaning: BYD's signature motorized center display that rotates 90 degrees between landscape and portrait orientations, criticized by reviewers as an unnecessary motor failure point that rattles on rough roads.
旋转屏.example_quote: 比亚迪这旋转屏除了交车时向朋友炫耀两次，平时转起来嘎吱异响还挡出风口。

趴窝.cultural_meaning: An EV completely losing drive power, bricking, or draining to 0% on the road or highway, leaving the driver stranded and requiring an emergency flatbed tow truck.
趴窝.example_quote: 刚上高速动力系统故障灯全亮，直接趴窝在应急车道，连双闪都闪得有气无力。

虚标.cultural_meaning: Official laboratory CLTC range numbers drastically exaggerating real-world driving range, where a vehicle advertised as 600km achieves barely 300-350km on winter highway conditions.
虚标.example_quote: 标称续航700公里，冬天开暖风跑高速实际只有320，虚标成这样都不算欺诈消费者吗？

锁电.cultural_meaning: Carmakers covertly restricting maximum usable battery capacity or voltage ceiling via stealth OTA software updates after thermal fire incidents, decreasing range to prevent spontaneous combustion without compensating owners.
锁电.example_quote: 厂家偷偷推了个升级包，升级完充到100%续航直接少50公里，这就是赤裸裸的锁电保平安！

偷鸡.cultural_meaning: Automakers quietly swapping advertised premium components (like CATL batteries, Bosch ESP, Continental tires) for cheaper second-tier domestic alternatives in production batches without notifying consumers.
偷鸡.korean_equiv: 몰래 원가절감 부품 갈아치우기 (눈속임 스펙 사기)
偷鸡.example_quote: 试驾车全是宁德时代电池，买到手一查变成中创新航，厂家偷鸡摸狗的把戏太熟练了。

铝换铁.cultural_meaning: Marketing high-end cast aluminum suspension control arms and subframes during pre-launch events, but swapping them for stamped iron or cast steel on subsequent volume production models to cut costs.
铝换铁.korean_equiv: 알루미늄 하체 강판 부품 몰래 교체
铝换铁.english_equiv: Aluminum suspension quietly swapped for steel
铝换铁.example_quote: 发布会宣称全铝双叉臂，量产交付拆开一看底盘全是黑漆冲压铁件，铝换铁骗谁呢？

欢乐表.cultural_meaning: Instrument cluster meters programmed to display flattering, inaccurate figures, such as showing energy consumption of 12 kWh/100km when actual wall plug consumption is 18 kWh/100km, or speedometers registering 100 km/h at real 92 km/h.
欢乐表.example_quote: 表显电耗11度看着真省，自己拿充电桩电表一算其实16度，纯粹是厂家哄人的欢乐表。

断轴.cultural_meaning: Catastrophic suspension ball joint or lower control arm fracture causing the wheel assembly to fold into the fender, a notorious defect seen on several early Chinese NEVs and imported models under low-speed impact.
断轴.example_quote: 只是拐弯蹭了下马路牙子前悬挂球头就断裂脱落，断轴断得让人心惊肉跳。

筷子悬架.cultural_meaning: Derogatory term for flimsy, pencil-thin stamped steel control links used in rear multi-link suspensions (famously targeted on early BYD Qin and Han models), resembling eating chopsticks that look prone to bending.
筷子悬架.example_quote: 趴下去看比亚迪三连杆后悬挂，细得跟两根筷子一样，难怪高速过弯飘得像开船。

移动火化炉.cultural_meaning: Extreme derogatory dark slang used on Chinese forums to describe EVs prone to violent battery thermal runaway fires that engulf the cabin in flames in seconds, making escape nearly impossible.
移动火化炉.korean_equiv: 바퀴 달린 화장터 (극단적 배터리 화재 비하어)
移动火化炉.example_quote: 电池碰撞几秒钟爆燃起火把门锁死，这种不给逃生机会的车简直就是移动火化炉。

自燃王.cultural_meaning: Label given to specific models or brands that frequently make news headlines for catching fire spontaneously while parked, idling, or fast-charging on hot summer days.
自燃王.example_quote: 停在露天车位大白天自己冒浓烟起火，不愧是榜上有名的自燃王。

龟速模式.cultural_meaning: Emergency safety protection mode where the vehicle cuts propulsion power severely (limiting top speed to 20-30 km/h and displaying a glowing yellow tortoise icon) due to battery over-discharge, cell voltage delta, or motor inverter overheating.
龟速模式.example_quote: 电量还剩10%上坡突然跳乌龟灯强制龟速模式，后面大货车疯狂按喇叭吓死人！

锁SOC.cultural_meaning: Factory BMS logic refusing to use the top or bottom 10-15% of battery buffer capacity, or artificially freezing the displayed percentage to mask severe cell imbalance and voltage sag.
锁SOC.korean_equiv: SOC 배터리 가용 구간 강제 제한
锁SOC.example_quote: 电量掉到20%直接断崖跌到0%，根本就是厂家锁SOC没校准好导致的跳电。

鬼火少年专用车.pinyin: guǐ huǒ shào nián zhuān yòng chē
鬼火少年专用车.literal_meaning: Vehicle exclusively for ghost-fire delinquent youths
鬼火少年专用车.cultural_meaning: Mocking high-horsepower, low-price electric sedans (0-100 km/h in 3-4s for under 200,000 RMB) bought by aggressive, reckless young drivers who tailgate, weave, and cause road accidents.
鬼火少年专用车.example_quote: 几十万的加速下放到十几万，满大街鬼火少年开着电车地板电乱窜，迟早害人害己。

幽灵刹车.cultural_meaning: The vehicle's ADAS autonomous cruise system suddenly slamming on emergency friction brakes at highway speeds due to shadows, overpasses, heat mirages, or radar noise, posing fatal rear-end collision risks.
幽灵刹车.example_quote: 高速开着领航辅助前边空无一物，突然一脚急刹减速到40，幽灵刹车差点害我被追尾！

画龙.cultural_meaning: Lane Centering Assist (LCA) algorithms failing to maintain a straight trajectory, constantly oscillating back and forth between left and right lane markings like an undulating Chinese dragon.
画龙.example_quote: 所谓的L2级车道保持在弯道里疯狂画龙，左右晃得人头晕，吓得我赶紧接管方向盘。

智驾画饼.literal_meaning: Drawing a pie for smart driving (selling false promises)
智驾画饼.cultural_meaning: EV executives hyping full urban autonomous driving (City NOA / FSD) capabilities during product launches that get continually delayed or released as barely functional beta software requiring constant driver disengagements.
智驾画饼.example_quote: 买车时吹嘘年底全国都能开城市导航，三年过去了还在画饼，纯属智驾画饼割韭菜。

遥遥领先.cultural_meaning: Huawei executive Richard Yu's infamous marketing phrase, used enthusiastically by Huawei fans (Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance / HIMA) but heavily satirized by critics whenever an AITO or Luxeed vehicle experiences software bugs, AEB failures, or delivery halts.
遥遥领先.example_quote: 倒车雷达延迟两秒撞柱子上了，这就是所谓的‘遥遥领先’？

活人墓碑.cultural_meaning: LiDAR and 3D perception visualization bugs where the instrument cluster renders imaginary humans, bicycles, or tombstone obstacles in completely empty parking garages or roadside tunnels, freaking out superstitious drivers.
活人墓碑.example_quote: 深夜进地库屏幕上突然显示车旁站了三个行人走动，明明四周一个人都没有，活人墓碑吓出冷汗。

车机卡顿.cultural_meaning: Laggy central displays, sluggish navigation redraws, and frozen app screens occurring after successive OTA updates bloat the automotive SoC chip, rendering essential climate controls inoperable.
车机卡顿.example_quote: 买车才一年系统更新两次就卡成幻灯片，连调个空调风量都要转圈圈等三秒。

哨兵耗电.cultural_meaning: Sentry security monitoring mode keeping cameras, GPUs, and computer processors awake 24/7, sucking 5-10% of battery capacity overnight and compounding phantom battery drain anxiety.
哨兵耗电.example_quote: 开了一晚上哨兵模式掉电7度，这哪是保镖啊，分明是个喝电的吞电兽！

OTA负优化.cultural_meaning: Software updates pushed over-the-air that downgrade vehicle attributes—limiting motor output, capping charging speeds, restricting ADAS speed limits, or complicating UI layouts—under the guise of safety improvements.
OTA负优化.example_quote: 每次OTA都心惊肉跳，更新完加速变肉了充电也变慢了，妥妥的官方负优化。

强制OTA.cultural_meaning: Vehicle infotainment aggressively forcing software downloads and initiating countdowns to install updates, occasionally bricking or locking owners out of the vehicle for an hour when they urgently need to commute.
强制OTA.example_quote: 赶着去上班车机突然倒计时强制OTA，车门关上趴在地库升级45分钟，完全不把车主当人。

工业垃圾.cultural_meaning: Extreme derogatory condemnation applied by netizens to shoddily designed or poorly engineered EVs plagued with persistent creaks, panel rattles, electronic gremlins, and zero driving dynamics.
工业垃圾.example_quote: 异响不断底盘松散刹车点头，这种拼凑出来的半成品也配上市？纯粹是工业垃圾！

杂牌电车.cultural_meaning: Humorous inversion where young Chinese consumers dismiss traditional German luxury legacy brands (Mercedes-Benz EQ series, BMW i3, Audi e-tron) as irrelevant, backward 'no-name' electric cars with poor smart cockpits.
杂牌电车.korean_equiv: 근본 없는 잡패 전기차 (레거시 EV 비하)
杂牌电车.example_quote: 三十万预算买蔚小理多香，谁还去买BBA那些油改电的杂牌电车啊？

油改电.cultural_meaning: Vehicles built on internal combustion engine chassis adapted with retrofitted battery packs, resulting in awkward floor humps, high center of gravity, low crash safety, and compromised interior legroom.
油改电.example_quote: 底盘中间高高隆起的传动轴鼓包出卖了一切，纯正的油改电不仅耗电而且后排顶头。

棺材车.cultural_meaning: Viral internet nickname targeting the Li Auto MEGA electric MPV, whose silver futuristic teardrop rear profile was maliciously photoshopped and labeled as resembling a Chinese funeral hearse, destroying sales momentum.
棺材车.english_equiv: Coffin-shaped EV (Li Auto MEGA PR disaster)
棺材车.example_quote: 理想MEGA尾部线条处理太诡异，网上铺天盖地刷‘灵车’‘棺材车’，彻底把高端形象玩砸了。

水军.cultural_meaning: Organized armies of paid online commentators deployed by automaker PR firms to manipulate forum threads, spam praise, drown out legitimate owner defect complaints, and mass-report critical vehicle reviews.
水军.example_quote: 只要发帖反映车辆异响，底下立马涌进来几十个水军账号洗版辱骂车主。

厂狗.cultural_meaning: Derogatory slur used in automotive forums against automaker employees, PR representatives, or dealership agents who pose as regular consumers to aggressively defend their brand's defects.
厂狗.example_quote: 别理那些洗地的厂狗，他们拿了厂家的公关费连断轴都能说成是车主驾驶不当。

饭圈造车.cultural_meaning: The toxic importation of idol fandom behavior into the automotive industry, where owners idolize company founders, violently attack competing brands, and treat technical criticism as personal blasphemy.
饭圈造车.example_quote: 现在的造车新势力搞饭圈造车那一套，车主群里天天喊口号打卡，说一句缺点就被群起攻之。

蔚来教.cultural_meaning: Satirical nickname for the cult-like devotion of early NIO owners who defend the brand fiercely because of luxury NIO House clubhouses, free coffee, exclusive parties, and founder charisma despite vehicle flaws.
蔚来教.english_equiv: The Church of NIO (cult-like NIO community)
蔚来教.example_quote: 蔚来教的信徒们买的根本不是车，而是几万块一杯的NIO House免费咖啡和管家式服务。

换电排长队.cultural_meaning: The holiday reality of battery swapping networks, where highway swap stations run out of charged batteries or suffer mechanical arm stalls, resulting in 1-2 hour waiting queues that erase the 3-minute swap boast.
换电排长队.example_quote: 国庆假期服务区换电站排了20辆车，换一块充好电的要等半小时，换电排长队比充电还折磨。

蔚三万.cultural_meaning: Satirical meme referencing NIO's repeated vows to reach 30,000 monthly deliveries, which repeatedly missed targets for quarters on end, leading financial analysts and netizens to mock the milestone as an unreachable mirage.
蔚三万.example_quote: 李斌每个季度都在吹下个月月销过三万，结果全网都在等‘蔚三万’何时能真正兑现。

理想套娃.cultural_meaning: Mocking Li Auto's SUV lineup (L6, L7, L8, L9) for using the exact same front fascia, halo headlights, and interior layout, scaled up like Russian nesting dolls to hit different price brackets with zero design variety.
理想套娃.english_equiv: Li Auto Matryoshka nesting doll design
理想套娃.example_quote: 理想把一款前脸放大缩小拉皮搞出L6到L9，这种俄罗斯套娃式设计真是把偷懒发挥到极致。

增程落后.cultural_meaning: Longstanding technical rivalry between pure EV advocates and Range-Extender (EREV) makers, where critics attack gas generator setups as obsolete transitional tech carrying dead weight.
增程落后.example_quote: 纯电大佬天天喷增程落后，但现实中老百姓跑长途还是买增程最不慌。

绿牌歧视.cultural_meaning: Social prejudice against NEVs (which carry green registration plates in China), such as underground parking garages banning green plates over fire fears, or gas station attendants prioritizing blue plates.
绿牌歧视.korean_equiv: 전기차 녹색 번호판 차별 (화재 공포 낙인)
绿牌歧视.example_quote: 酒店地下车库门口赫然立个牌子‘绿牌新能源车严禁入内’，绿牌歧视简直不可理喻。

降价刺客.cultural_meaning: Sudden, unannounced official price slashes executed right after an owner takes delivery, destroying immediate resale equity and creating deep buyer resentment.
降价刺客.example_quote: 周末刚按原价提车，周一官方直接官降两万五，降价刺客杀人诛心！

终身质保套路.pinyin: zhōng shēn zhì bǎo tào lù
终身质保套路.cultural_meaning: Automaker marketing boasting 'lifetime battery/powertrain warranty', but burying harsh disqualification clauses in microscopic terms: mandatory expensive annual 4S shop servicing, mileage limits under 30,000 km/year, or voiding if any minor cosmetic body shop repair is done externally.
终身质保套路.korean_equiv: 평생 보증 꼼수 약관 (보증 무효 함정)
终身质保套路.example_quote: 说是三电终身质保，结果在外面补个胎换个雨刷就判定脱保，全都是终身质保套路！

续航打折.cultural_meaning: The drastic drop in real-world driving distance compared to official catalog ratings, especially severe during northern winter sub-zero temperatures where highway range drops to a '50% discount' (5折) or '40% discount' (4折).
续航打折.example_quote: 零下十度开高速空调暖风，标称600公里实际跑260就趴窝，续航直接打四折太恐怖。

充电罚款.cultural_meaning: Exorbitant idle occupancy penalty fees (up to 3-6 RMB per minute) billed by fast-charging station networks (such as Tesla Superchargers and State Grid) if an owner does not disconnect and vacate the parking bay within 5 minutes of charging completion.
充电罚款.korean_equiv: 충전 점유 점거 과태료 (분당 과금 폭탄)
充电罚款.english_equiv: Charging station idle occupation penalty fee
充电罚款.example_quote: 充满电在商场吃饭耽误了半小时，出来一看手机账单被扣了一百多充电罚款肉疼死。

盲订割韭菜.cultural_meaning: Persuading consumers to put down non-refundable or lock-in deposits on new EV models before official pricing, final hardware specs, or third-party press test drives are published, leaving buyers stuck with inferior production builds.
盲订割韭菜.example_quote: 连试驾都没开放就搞盲订割韭菜，等提车才发现底盘调校一团糟连退都退不了。

提车即贬值.literal_meaning: Depreciating the moment the car is picked up
提车即贬值.cultural_meaning: The horrific second-hand market value retention of Chinese EVs, where driving off the dealer lot can instantly wipe 30% to 40% off market value due to rapid tech obsolescence, price wars, and battery health skepticism.
提车即贬值.korean_equiv: 출고 즉시 감가 폭탄 (중고차 가격 폭락)
提车即贬值.english_equiv: Instant resale depreciation off the lot
提车即贬值.example_quote: 刚落地开了一个月想置换，二手车贩子直接砍半报价，电车真是提车即贬值。

半成品上路.literal_meaning: Half-baked / unfinished products pushed onto the road
半成品上路.cultural_meaning: Releasing EVs with incomplete software features (ADAS disabled, HUD missing modes, Bluetooth stuttering) and rushed factory assembly, promising that 'it will be fixed in next month's OTA update'.
半成品上路.example_quote: 辅助驾驶不能用，车机动不动黑屏，厂家拿我们当免费内测员，完全是半成品上路！

减配.cultural_meaning: The systematic quiet removal of physical buttons, passenger vanity mirrors, fog lights, cargo tonneau covers, or radar sensors in newer model years under the pretext of 'minimalism' or 'smart efficiency' while maintaining or slightly discounting car prices.
减配.example_quote: 改款新车取消了雷达还把后排遮阳帘减配了，美其名曰极简主义，实则是不要脸的减配省钱。
